`PlatformDispatcher.instance.onError` returns `true` (marks handled) while only calling `dart:developer`'s `log`, which is a no-op in release AOT. Production crashes vanish with no reporting.

- **`RefreshIndicator` wraps non-scrollable children** — `lib/features/product/presentation/view/product_list_view.dart:38-49`. In the loading and error branches the child is a `Center`, so pull-to-refresh is inert exactly when the user needs it.
